title: Tanshinone IIA promotes apoptosis by downregulating BCL2 and upregulating TP53 in triple-negative breast cancer.
authors: Liu, Jinfeng; Zhang, Chang; Liu, Shuang; Wang, Xiaokang; Wu, Xiongzhi; Hao, Jian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丹参酮IIA通过调控BCL2/TP53诱导三阴性乳腺癌凋亡，仅含小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Tanshinone IIA (Tan IIA) was mainly used for cardiovascular disease treatment. Recent studies have demonstrated the role of Tan IIA for tumor treatment, but its mechanism remains unclear. At the first, the inhibitory effect of Tan IIA on 4T1 breast cancer cells was determined by CCK8 and colony formation assay. Then, a 4T1 BALB/c model of breast cancer was established to evaluate the anti-cancer effect of Tan IIA in vivo. Flow cytometry analysis and the TUNEL test were used to detect cell apoptosis in vitro and in vivo, respectively. The related targets and mechanisms of Tan IIA were predicted through network-based systems biology. At last, molecular docking and the molecular biological techniques were used to evaluate the predicted targets. Tan IIA displayed encouraging inhibitory influences on 4T1 cells after incubation for 24 h and showed a half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) of 49.78 muM after 48-h incubation. After 23 days of treatment, the relative tumor volumes in the Tan IIA group were 65.53% inhibited compared with the control group. Furthermore, Tan IIA induced 4T1 cell apoptosis both in vivo and in vitro. The possible targets of Tan IIA for TNBC treatment were predicted with network-based systems biology, and results showed that TP53, NF-kappaB, AKT, MYC, and BCL-2 were the hub targets. The mechanism against breast cancer may be based on the P53 signaling pathway, the PI3K/Akt pathway, the MAPK signaling pathway, and the mTOR signaling pathways. Molecular docking analysis reveals that Tan IIA has a high affinity for p53, Bcl-2, and NF-kappaB1; the binding energies were - 6.92, - 6.07, and - 6.28 kcal/mol, respectively. The predicted proteins were further validated using Western blotting. Increased expression of phosphorylated p53 and p53 and decreased expression of Bcl-2 were found in Tan IIA-treated 4T1 cells. Tan IIA is potentially effective for the treatment of 4T1 breast cancer, and the molecular mechanism may be through enhancing the activity of p53 and decreasing Bcl-2 to suppress proliferation and promote apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 丹参酮IIA（Tan IIA）主要用于心血管疾病治疗。近期研究已证明Tan IIA在肿瘤治疗中的作用，但其机制尚不明确。首先，通过CCK8和集落形成实验测定了Tan IIA对4T1乳腺癌细胞的抑制作用。随后，建立了4T1 BALB/c乳腺癌模型，以评估Tan IIA在体内的抗癌效果。分别使用流式细胞术分析和TUNEL实验检测体外和体内的细胞凋亡。通过基于网络的系统生物学预测了Tan IIA的相关靶点和机制。最后，采用分子对接和分子生物学技术评估预测的靶点。Tan IIA在孵育24小时后对4T1细胞显示出令人鼓舞的抑制作用，并在孵育48小时后显示出半数抑制浓度（IC50）为49.78 μM。治疗23天后，与对照组相比，Tan IIA组的相对肿瘤体积被抑制了65.53%。此外，Tan IIA在体内和体外均诱导了4T1细胞凋亡。通过基于网络的系统生物学预测了Tan IIA治疗三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）的可能靶点，结果显示TP53、NF-kappaB、AKT、MYC和BCL-2是核心靶点。其抗乳腺癌机制可能基于P53信号通路、PI3K/Akt通路、MAPK信号通路和mTOR信号通路。分子对接分析显示，Tan IIA对p53、Bcl-2和NF-kappaB1具有高亲和力；结合能分别为-6.92、-6.07和-6.28 kcal/mol。预测的蛋白质通过Western blotting进一步验证。在Tan IIA处理的4T1细胞中，发现磷酸化p53和p53的表达增加，而Bcl-2的表达减少。Tan IIA可能有效治疗4T1乳腺癌，其分子机制可能通过增强p53活性和降低Bcl-2来抑制增殖并促进凋亡。
